text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum trailing Bitcoin by a larger margin, suggesting selective weakness in altcoin conviction. The Fear & Greed index at 25 signals extreme fear despite a slight 7-day improvement, while Bitcoin dominance holding above 56% and moderate volume of $69B indicate the market is contracting rather than panicking into outflows. Risk appetite remains muted across the board, with smaller caps like Solana also in the red.
